auto_clarifications: Use AgentTestBenchService, AgentTestRepository, artifact storage references, workflow publish-gate services, usage summaries, and audit records as the source of truth; React receives only backend-owned projections.

Use mocked-safe or deterministic local execution modes only; no real provider, connector, credential, external tool, or outbound calls run unless an explicit approved artifact marks a live probe path.

Resolve only persisted, authorized, current-scope workflow, profile, suite, case, and publish-gate requirement records; missing, stale, or cross-tenant references return unavailable, stale, or denied states.

Persist run launch requests with idempotency and revision evidence, poll durable run and step state, and show pending or unavailable progress when evidence is absent rather than fabricating completion.

Display safe summaries, artifact references, hashes, access outcomes, timestamps, and audit references only; raw transcripts, prompts, completions, run payloads, traces, local paths, stack traces, and unsafe artifact content never render.
